text: Hardly the game it used to be. Over the years, they have removed so many good features (Dreamworld, timed levels, moves levels, unique map locations, cutscences, the old music...). Obviously there are way more levels now than there were then, but they all just feel way less enjoyable and they changed a lot of the obstacles for the worse. King if you see this, you are making some very bad decisions, I think everyone would appreciate if the old maps and songs and levels were brought back.

The only game I pay to play although since the prices have increased in the last week I won't be paying to play anymore. One of the bundles was to help through hard levels, it was 2.99, today however it's increased in price to 3.99. And 8.99 to empty the piggy bank to receive 60 gold. That's just pure greed. And it's taking the fun out of the game.

If there was an option for Zero stars that would be my preference. I've had enough. This "game" is no longer a game. It has become an algorithm. ie. entirely based on 'luck'. At one time you had to use your brain and a level of skill to pass levels. No longer! Not enough moves for each level. Many are impossible, without the 'right' candies being in the algorithm. After 1300 levels, I GIVE UP. After 127 times and about 6 weeks on one level. Oh and has anyone EVER won the daily spin jackpot??

I agree with a lot of other users. This used to be an enjoyable game, one where I would look forward to playing. But now it's become almost impossible to pass any level without gold bars or power-ups! It's also turned very competitive in the way that to win gold bars/power ups, etc, you need to win levels against other players, or you never gain any extras! I've been playing this for years, and I'm over level 10000, but lately, it's put me off playing. I genuinely don't like this game anymore!

It's amazing and a great game to play without getting bored. It's addictive as you challenge yourself to keep playing until u pass a level which can be annoying sometimes. I love how there's races against other plays to see who can complete the most first or how many they can complete. There's no ads unless you want extra moves in q game and overall, i think it's quite fun.

Game has pretty much become like all the rest, PAY TO WIN. hence star rating dropped. When it first came out, it was fun, challenging at times, now it has become predictable everytime I log in, win 1 or 2 levels, then 5 losses game over until recharge - or buy lives... then when I log in the following day, oh look - I can complete the level easily. !!! I play for the fun, not to pay. ! SORRY, you've made it too Money orientated for such a popular game.

Addictive! Love this game to pass time. The levels get harder the more you pass, I've reached around 6100 and every 2nd or 3rd level is extremely difficult to pass with available moves unless you spend money to get extra ones. Too many pop ups once you finish a level. Bonus' for collecting certain items changed from 30 mins of lives to 10-30 mins of 'special sweets'. Deleted and will find another game.

I have reached level 3880 of this mostly enjoyable game. For the last week however, it has become extremely frustrating. On the Candy Royale challenge where you have to win 7 levels in a row at the first attempt, and if you do you share a whole load of gold bars, after each level when you tap to continue, the screen freezes for ages. I have to switch off for about half an hour then go back. This keeps happening on every single level. Please try to get this fixed.

Fun game to pass the time while listening to podcasts. But there are waaay too many pop ups, theres too much going on! Simplify. Its just a matching game, theres too much of "spin this", "feed that", "pick this thing". Naw. Edit: Recently reinstalled to find the difficulty has increased tenfold, and the game is now designed to get you stuck on the same level for days unless you watch ads. Uninstalling.

I'm pretty cross. I've been playing this game for over 6 years??? On level 5068 ... The latest update is terrible. We no longer can watch an ad to get a special candy. It's making passing extremely hard and not fun to play. The constant buy buy buy is infuriating! Competitions start, disappear and then tell you they've finished and your still on the same blooming level. I'm not enjoying this game anymore and thinking of uninstalling to reclaim my life back.

Keeps crashing sort it out pls!! Ok 2 days later, I've had to delete and re load the game, and i've lost all my extras!! i.e color bombs, gold bars!! It's the 2nd time this has happened! I've passed level 5250 and with no extra's, it's like starting over again. this time it's not worth it, need to find a more reliable game!!

This is a very good game overall. It takes a certain amount of skill and strategy, along with some luck. The pop-ups don't bother me (I just ignore them; my focus is on moving on to the next level), and I don't often purchase boosters to help me beat the levels, as I pride myself on learning from my mistakes and using that to keep improving my skill and strategy. I advise those who have commented negatively on this game to read my review and consider the points I've made, as they may help you.

Sometimes, when you are on a streak, the game is amazing. However, lately, I have just been on one hard level after the other, not getting far for months. Incredibly frustrating and absolutely not a game to "swipe your stress away." A better saying for them would be "increase stress levels with each swipe" Also, all those stupid pop-ups that you keep having to close in between games are incredibly annoying, and there seem to be more pop-ups as the years pass.

An amazing game super fun to pass time or if you're in a long car journey. Also it is annoying when you run out of lives though being annoying I get why they have done this. The only thing is you have top pay money and there is constantly ads popping up saying to buy things. But all in all this is an amazing and addictive game which you SHOULD download it.

I used to love this game but I uninstalled 3 days ago, I got to level 3279 and it just isn't fun anymore. They want you to purchase, extra gold bars, extra lives, extra everything it can make certain levels almost impossible to pass. It deliberately won't give you ad's to watch to help with your progress. I've had enough, when a game ceases to be fun or relaxing it's definitely time to get rid of said game!!

A fun game without annoying adverts. Enjoyable differing level of difficulty as you progress through the games. I used to enjoy this game but the latest update (2020) keeps causing it to crash when trying to win extra moves or boosters. Sometimes the game doesn't open properly either and it closes itself straight away. Please sort it out and give me all my lost boosters and games back!!!

It's only after your money! WARNING!! This game is a con, level 3159 for example gives you only 15 moves which means it's virtually impossible to complete. The only way is to pay money to defeat the level. Look on app tipper and the level shows you have 30 moves. CCS uses an algorithm that spots when you are good and changes the number of moves needed to complete levels to force you to pay to beat it! You have been warned. Just Google their profits!!!

In the hard times We're going through I wish the game would have a bit of leinicty and offer more rewards. I've been playing this game for over 10 years and of late I've been paying more money to keep playing. There's no offers like there used to be. Very disappointed on how you make it harder so we pay more money! I'm gonna advise others not to start playing this game..because it got worse and greedy!

Please stop changing the limit on the amount of lives you can receive daily, in fact, please just scrap it. Disproportionate amount of hard a d super hard levels in the higher levels. I am over 12000 levels in but lately I've noticed that there are just more and more super hard and hard levels per area meaning I guess you just want us to spend more money trying to pass levels. Now you've limited the number of lives we can accept from people; you're just trying to make more money off people.

It's okay. The art is vibrant and colourful and the music is inoffensive. I advise to switch off the flashing hints as they can ruin the fun and strategic nature of the game. I disliked having to wait a while before being able to play again. Think of it like a casino slot machine where the odds are deliberately stacked against the player, and you realise it's more a game of chance than skill. Fortunately I never became addicted or spent money on this game. Uninstalled.

Edit- Changed to 5 stars now as recently downloaded again and all the bugs have been fixed! Fab game. I absolutely love this game, play it all the time. The only problem is that it crashes every single time I play it, ill be half way through a level an then it freezes an then shuts my phone off. Any help would be awesome, would be a 5 star rating if it wasn't for this!!

Can quite easily spend 3 or 4 hours at a time on this game. It is addictive. That is until you get to level where it just decides to not let you win. I've used up all my lives, reloaded twice. Bought every booster I could and it still won't let me past. It does get you frustrated when it seems to purposely sabotage your strategy. When you've 1 or 2 moves left and you need to mix two candies to clear a level, it'll drop a candy that will explode one of them and waste a life.

Seems to have sorted out the freezing issue quickly. Really like this game but far too many pop ups when you first log in or between rounds. I also seem to have lost the fantastic 5 group I had with my friends, I'm still in the group but didn't show on my app, and when I complete levels and use boosters it's says I haven't won any points on there end.

The problem with this game is when collecting items such as the chocolate from the mixer (it's very slow to be created - I've not reached a goal many times because of this) or when it has to come from the "gumdrop" machine, it takes ages. I just wasted about 8 hand switch moves hoping for one last licorice to come out as I had one move left but it didn't come! Had to waste another 16 gold bars to keep playing and pass the extremely hard level. Sort it!!

I love the game, been playing for years. Recently been having issues. I made a purchase and it was never credited to my account. Following advice I uninstalled and reinstalled the game . I now can't log in to my account with Facebook, I get a message saying connection issues yet I have perfect internet connection. These issues really need to be sorted out!!

Game keeps crashing over the last week or so. No point in playing it till fixed. Otherwise, when working, reat fun. Annoying as hell pop ups have at last lessened although they are still present. Bad that you can win/gain gold bars but then have to pay for them therefore no point. There should be an option to take off the "helping/highlighting" of what's the next possible move. So.... Because of the constant crashing issue it's only 1 star for now

A very good and fun game......when you actually get to play it. After every level you have to click through nearly a minute's worth of pop-ups for leaderboards, item rewards, more learderboards, more item rewards and of course, advertising for in-app purchases. Like I said, really great and fun game, but waaay too many things to click 'X' on to the point where I get too annoyed to play the game.

When I first started playing, it was actually quite a good distraction for my anxiety. It was easy to follow/play & not too demanding, or trying to get you to spend more money & download other games. Now, unfortunately it's hardly about the game at all, the pop ups are constant & sometimes 2 or 3 at once before you can start your next game. Lastly, sometimes the challenges are ridiculous, with regards to how much time you have to finish a game. Unless you want to spend more money on more lives.

I tested this game and have just deleted my account after playing for only 2 weeks. It's too expensive to play ( if you want to play and compete at the highest level). A lot of levels don't come with enough moves. Often 15 or 16 moves for very hard levels. So you are forced to buy boosters or buy moves to pass the level. You don't get much from winning races , so you end up spending real money and it does not last. Please make the game fair. Increase the gold bar rewards and moves

I've been playing the various Candy Crush games for a few years now, and one thing that really annoys me, is the inability to transfer boosters from one phone to another. I had saved well over 800 on this game, specifically for use once I'd reached level 3,000, so imagine my mood when I got a new phone at level 3048, and saw that I'd lost them all! If gold bars, and levels can be saved, why not boosters?

Always a lot of fun, a game that keeps you entertained. Though now there are so many additional stuff you have to be part of... Feels like the point of the game has been lost a bit because you have scrolls to collect, check in every day to collect your prize, the game became a responsibility. The whole point of it was to relax and enjoy the challenge, not complete tasks to receive a golden star - that's what jobs are for.

Got to level 1500 or so without facebook, decided to "save my progress". Once I'd made that mistake the system refuses to allow you to win levels, constantly wanting you to purchase "boosters". I understand the devs are running a business but there is not enough incentive when you can only win at 2 levels before getting stuck again. Uninstalled.

I've played this game for a number of years and have not had to purchase any boosters etc, but have now just got to level 3000. I took a break for about a year or so but never deleted the game so was able to just click in and go again when I was ready. I can agree with alot of the reviews on here......my fb friends hardly play this game anymore and nor do most, but it's still a good challenge, and a relaxing way to pass the time. My advice to anyone who does still play is to strap in and be prepared for the long journey. It's been over 6yrs for sure.......

One of the only mobile games that doesn't bombard you with unskippable third-party ads, so I'll give it a star for that. Other than that, it's a poorly designed "game" that employs random difficulty spikes to get the player to spend money on boosts, just to get them through these artificially difficult levels. No satisfying pacing whatsoever due to this, so I can't give any more than 2 stars. Very boring and generic overall, won't be redownloading anytime soon.

Since the last update, every time I watch the video to get a free colour bomb it gets stuck and won't load. Very frustrating! And I understand that you earn your money from impatient people trying to get to the next level but having to wait three days is taking the piss. Not to mention that some of the extras I win like the wheel can't be used for the next level and end up disappearing which is a complete con designed to make you pay for extras.

It's a very clever set up. You'll win plenty of levels without paying anything. Then comes the turn. You'll soon find yourself on a level which is nigh on impossible to complete. The offers come at you quickly...'pay now for bonuses to complete!' or 'don't lose your streak'. You may not want to spend actual money but they will try their best to entice you. Don't fall for the scam!

The game has become near unplayable. For the first couple of hundred levels you will fly through, then you hit a brick wall. Events like Volcano Panic will make certain levels impossible unless you use gold to gain moves, and of course you have to pay money for the gold. So you wait three days for the event to end, and then you get past the level, to be rewarded with all the boosters, but then the level is super hard and no boosters are allowed. It is not fun to play, such a shame

The new sparkly graphics are really off putting and make it hard to concentrate on the game. I won't be able to play as much as it hurts my eyes. From reading other reviews I don't think I'm the only one. Such a shame as I've been playing this game. 01/07 - ads keep crashing the game forcing me to close it and lose progress. This needs to be sorted out

I do enjoy this game, but... there are some very obvious issues with it. 1. 1 move left - the amount of times that i have lost needing only one more move makes it feel like a fix. There is no point playing something that is predetermknd. 2. Lucky beans - never get 2 in a row without getting caught. Basically get one per go or dont bother playing. 3. Piggy bank - has 30 gold bars you CANT access, literally pointless?? You should be able to withdraw them surely. Pay to play basically

Have played since near the beginning, but lately, it's become clear that this is just about trying to get you to purchase packs, the levels are mostly impossible, far too few moves, so there's no actual skill as you have no chance anyway. The fish never eat what they are supposed to, makes me cross what is the point of them????! if you get a power up it blows before you can launch it, I purchased a pack, money taken, but no pack given, so no, will not buy to pass a level.

Mediocre game, fun if you want an addictive game to turn off your brain, I have a bit of a problem with deleting accounts though. I played the game for a few minutes a year after I last played it however I got bored and I wanted to delete my account only to find that there is no button for it! You have to contact them through the website which is so odd! I couldn't be bothered to delete my account in the end but I will advise if you are unsure test the game, then make an account!

The 'keep playing' button to use gold bars is not working most of the time. I think it may be tied to if you have any other free boosters being activated but I can't be sure. It does seem to work if you log out of your account and back in again. Its very annoying. Its very frustrating as I want to keep playing and beat the level I'm on.

Excellent game format but the prices are ridiculous expensive , no one needs to pay that much for additional boosts . While there are some free ones to be had they are insufficient for the higher levels , you can end up getting stuck on the same level for days . Overall a fun and addictive casual game but you *will* need to make the most of the things you can get for free and have patience if you don't want to be spending silly money to progress.

I concur with some of the other reviews here. The later levels are clearly channelling the user to paying money. Each one is based on pure luck and takes about a week (maybe 100 tries) each before a lucky board is presented. Compared to other games like Homescapes etc. this is very poor. I've ended up deleting three times now, keep thinking it'll be different and a good passer of time, but it's not. When revenue is being generated through ads etc. there is really no need for this.

You guys are scam artists. I've been playing this game of almost 10yrs. Playing ads to get extra moves, lives or spins has always been a part of the Game platy. ONE PURCHASE and all that disappears. That's disrespectful to the players. I've also noticed that the lives gifted from friends has stopped aswell. Now anytime I want extra moves/lives/spinsI have to use gold coins, that I have to spend money to purchase. And don't say "beta-testing" as an excuse;other players have said the same thing.

Had to delete the app because the candy crush ads were ruining other games I play. Every time I played a game with a candy crush adverts, no matter how careful you are you can't close the app and takes you straight to app instead. Can't go back or stop this and it closes the game I was originally playing which means I need to reload over and over because of the candy crush ad.

Came back to play this and it's worse, the skull levels are stupidly hard but even worse is that the non skull levels are just as bad. You may aswell make them all skull difficulty levels. I'd say it's done on purpose to get people to buy items from Store. Also the stupid glitch this game has is rediculous, if I turn my phone by mistake the app closes and I lose a life if playing a level.

just enough of a challenge to be enjoyable and not purely frustrating. you don't have to spend money chasing lifes and bonuses, it does build back up over time. plenty of challenges and levels to tackle. of course some levels can be time and lives consuming and seem like you will never crack, but if they were all easy then there would be no challenge!

I guess you have enough people playing you aren't bothered about reading reviews or listening to feedback. For anyone reading - if you're stuck on a level for more than a day or two just don't play the game for like a week or so. Next time you go on, you'll win that "impossible" level first time, probably with sugar stars. Happens every single time. The game is fixed until it wants you to win. And when you ain't played for over a week - it always wants you to win and start playing again.

Getting very close now to uninstalling this game, no entertainment value anymore, so many changes and updates. No free spins, 30 second advert for one extra move, or the game cuts out halfway through, the makers are strongly trying to encourage people to spend money of extras so that you pass certain levels. Now looking for a new more enjoyable game to past half an hour. I strongly wouldn't recommend this game now.

I've been playing Candy Crush for over 10 years. Not any longer, the game is fixed now so you have to either spend money or leave the game for a while to progress again. On the Elite Challenge you needed to pass 21 levels in a row to win over 100 bars of gold. I knew exactly what was going to happen, I passed 20 levels then failed the 21st. You can extend the game by watching 3 adverts to gain extra lives. Surprise surprise, the adverts cut out leaving me short. They worked before perfectly

After they've changed one of the stuff (the fishes) the games is basically utter playable. Stucked on a level where I have to use the fishes and instead of the 3 candies it take out only one. Uninstalled. Stucked on tgat level for 3 days, wasted more than 30 lives and about 30 bonuses. Watched 30 adverts to get even worse scores... uninstalled. Few years later: it's a pay to win game. (Or watch trillion ads to not get thru some levels. Pathetic.) Uninstalled again. Will try in 2-3 years

Unistalling, used to absolutely love this game, but it really does seem the higher you get the more it crashes. Got free boosters for completing a level, only to use them, to complete the next level for the game to crash at what it seems to be "the right time" for them. Refreshed the game to find all my lives taken, my boosters of course taken where I'd used them and back on the level that I'd completed prior. Dont install unless you're best please to be frustrated!

Suffers the same problem as with all Candy Crush games, too many pop ups. I'd just like to launch the game and start playing, not having to close so many pop ups!!!! Game itself is ok. Just be aware it's a slog if you don't pay to win levels (usually buying from the pop ups!!), and you'll then suddenly win a level you're stuck on, so I don't think there's much skill involved it's predetermined, as stated like all the other Candy Crush games.

This isn't just a textbook definition of pay to win, it's basically a textbook definition of pay to play. Without buying their packs and boosters you have zero chance of completing their nonstop challenges, let alone competing with your opponents in said challenges, there was one player who had apparently completed more levels in 2 days than I had in 3 weeks of playing. Waste of time.

Don't bother...I used to play this years ago, and after 3 years I gave up, because you had to pay money to pass the levels by using the cheats. Nothing has changed, decided to give it another go...and it's impossible to pass the higher levels without help...so unless you get a few freebies, you have to pay to buy help to pass the levels.....such a shame that the company has become so greedy

Started off well. But as usual greedy developers make it impossible to progress without spending cash. I have been stuck on level 255 now for 2 days and it is just impossible to get any further. I refuse to spend money as I think the promoters of the game are getting a fortune from all the ads that have to be watched to get anywhere in this game. I am at the point if I don't get past level 255 today then it will have to be uninstalled! 👎👎👎👎👎👎

After completing a level I counted at least 5 pop ups. I just want to play puzzles not have trash thrown in my face. If I wanted to take part I'd press the events or one of the numerous icons on left side of the level select screen. Just tonnes of bloated rubbish that I don't want to pay for. I refuse to pay for gold .. anything you have to pay for to complete is not a game anymore and kills the fun and the planet too ..all these servers running for pointless games draining the planets energy.

Uninstalled this! It's IMPOSSIBLE to proceed past certain levels without in app purchases! And you get no benefits for being on level 7000 odd! You still only get 5 lives the same as someone on level 7! And funny how every single time you're on the penultimate level to win Candy Royale and an episode race you get stuck on an impossible level to ruin it all. Sneaky!

Used to be great. I don't mind paying every now and then for extra help. That's my choice. But recently levels have become impossible without boosters or a large number of extra moves, which means paying for extra gold bars. Also , I recently bought extra moves as I was one level away from winning gold bars in Candy Royale. When I won the last 7th level, Candy Royale disappeared. This has happened on more than one occasion, which leads me to think it's deliberate, verging on fraudulent.

I find it very strange that so many reviewers complain that "the game wants them to spend money". Candy Crush is not a sweet charity, it is a business with the aim of making money off us. Giving people the option to watch ads instead of forking out cash was an acceptable alternative but lately this is no longer an option and I refuse to pay money for a silly game. Oh and the amount of clicks between levels is ridiculous. BYE!

Who thought level 532 was a good idea!?! Can't lie I thought I would hate this game with a passion and it was for bored people sat at home but it's been fun..... Until the later levels where the business model is obvious make the levels so hard where you need a fluke to complete them or start to spend spend spend. I don't mind I've had my fun for more hours that I would admit but uninstalled today as it goes from fun to frustrating very quickly

This game in its original format was good and enjoyable and challenging. Over the last couple of years it has changed dramatically, From being what I have already said, To being a game which is frustrating and one which you have to pay to progress. As a player of 10 years I am now shortly going to uninstall this game as it is no longer one you can play with any satisfaction or enjoyment.

I’ve played Candy Crush for years and just hit level 10,000. It used to be a fantastic game, but now levels feel impossible without paying for moves or boosters, and every time I buy, the prices seem to increase, which feels unfair. Unlike other games, there's no way to earn free gold bars. King should really listen to the reviews—longtime players are frustrated, and the star rating keeps dropping. Candy Crush was once great, but it’s becoming too focused on profit over player experience.

some levels are impossible to beat without boosters. these have always been very expensive but now the price has increased and the piggy bank has went from 60 bars for 2.99 to 30 bars for 2.99. app is designed to be addictive.... ever notice how you are so so close to completing a level on your last life? to panic you into buying more moves or lives. I'm on level 3898, have spent a lot of money but the recent huge leap in price means I have to delete the game to prevent me from spending.

It's basically a line game w/ a move limit, & just that. It's repetitive. It becomes weary if played in a manner other than casually. It's good for passing time on public transport, but it doesn't qualify as a good computer game. It's a game of luck, not logic. It's also freemium. If you're planning on playing it passionately, don't. It's a luck- based finger tapper, barely qualifying as a decent computer game. It's a beautiful game w/ outdated gameplay. It's beautifully outdated.

I have enjoyed this game, overall, for years with some ups and downs with challenging levels and rated it at 5*. Lately though, there are ads which will not let you get back to the game , often when you are watching ads for extra goes, so you have to close and start again...so annoying. Please sort this out King . Update..7 months on and nothing has changed

It used to be a decent game, but not anymore. After you complete any level, theres at least 3 pop-ups of absolutely rage inducing stupid things, which you 99% of the time dont care about. It's definitely just a stupid engagement metric tactic. You can't play the game in peace anymore without it begging you to spend money. It's even worse when you've been away for a week. I logged in after 7 days afk and got like 20 pop-ups. I quit and deleted the game. I'll find something else to play. Morons.

I was enjoying the game until I reached lv146, the level just impossible even with boosters which I brought. I purchased a offer with few active boosters for an hour, which was complete waste of money. I failed five times so then to keep using active boosters you have throw more money to buy more lives not happening. Unless you got a few thousand pounds to waste, stay clear of the game as it wouldn't even scratch the surface to help complete the game.

NOT RELAXING!! Decided to return to the game 3 weeks ago and gave it enough chances.. I've spent days stuck on levels multiple times and probably only passed 30 levels across 3 weeks... On level 3500+ and it's definitely not how I want to spend any more of my time feeling incompetent.. I used to love the satisfaction of passing levels.. it relaxed me and I used to sit spending 2+ hours playing away.. Passing 80+ levels in a sitting... Nowadays I want to give up after 10 mins!! NO ENJOYMENT!!

Not worth even 1 star. It's so obviously rigged that it's just laughable. I struggled on one level over and over, and as soon as I used some of the gold bars I won from a race, suddenly the game finished the level in the next move. Hmmm, wonder why it suddenly got so easy and beatable in 2 seconds? I don't understand how some people can get to level 3000 or 5000 or whatever. I got to around 500 and got so frustrated at the obvious rigged system and couldn't do it any more.

Enjoyed playing many levels, but eventually got bored as levels that weren't deemed as hard levels were near on impossible. I like a challenge so did persevere but just took forever with many of the levels. Also I was gaining gold blocks and when I reached the max the only thing I could do with the gold blocks is pay £2.99 to buy another piggy bank, couldn't even use the gold blocks! Had fun for a few weeks, uninstalled now.

Do NOT install this app!!! Nearly every level is a near miss to make you purchase and even then you are 1 bar away from getting 5 moves that create nothing. There are so many other apps out there that are so much easier and enjoyable that don't make you regret wasting hard earned money at the most awful time. Scandalous.

I really enjoyed this game and it is easy to get through levels with help of boosters and spending nothing. I was determined not to spend cash. However, I reached level 147 and thought a few pounds OK. That was how it started. The encouragement to spend quite a lot on nothing, is full-on. Constantly. Everything is money and it goes quickly so spend more it says. Its harder to resist. A game that will run away with your money. I found I had spent £45!! No more. Set a limit. BE GAMBLING AWARE!!!!

Used to enjoy the game and I installed and played the game for many times since several years ago. Now I'm at level 330 and I believe it's getting a pay-to-win game. The moves are too low for the amount of candies which are needed to be collected. It's getting rly annoying, unlike their motto which is "relax and play". I'm getting more nervous than being relaxed.

Returner to the game and its nice to not be interrupted by an ad every level! This seems to be norm nowadays but not here and I hope it stays that way. I'm not at particularly high level nor do I play every day so don't have the issues as other users seem to have with levels being impossibly hard. I'm just enjoying playing a couple levels whilst the baby sleeps without a mandatory ad with terrible acting about earning money whilst you play or trying to get you to save a king from drowning!

Good game, but... I can't help feeling that level 425 is completely rigged. It's literally impossible to complete with the given moves and forces you to spend gold bars. I got through around a hundred and was no closer to getting through it. It's clearly a trap to force you into making a purchase. Such a shame, but I will be uninstalling.

Not only has chocolate box stopped working, the messages greyed out and I logged out to reset and it won't allow my back in through Facebook. I have checked and it is active in my Facebook and I have checked the app is up to date. There are no clear solutions on the King webpage. I have been playing for years and so disappointed with be recent events.
